anomalies.obs: On the EPD_Driver sheet, C1 is drawn as 0.1 µF / 16 V, sitting at the boost-converter input node in parallel with C2 (1 µF / 6.3 V) between the Display_Power_Switch rail and GND.
anomalies.expected: The design specification's EPD-driver matching table states that Meshinger C1 belongs to the PDI 'C2 default' group and is 1 µF / 25 V ('C2 default: 1 µF/25 V → C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V'). The reference design therefore intends a 1 µF / 25 V part in the C1 position, not 0.1 µF / 16 V.

evidence.quote: C2 default: 1 µF/25 V → C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V

anomalies.impact: C1's capacitance and voltage rating both differ from the intended reference value (1 µF/25 V). This is a value+rating deviation in the EPD boost stage's input/charge-pump network; it changes the input filtering seen by the boost converter relative to the validated PDI reference circuit and, if C1 was meant to be a 25 V-rated pump/input cap, the 16 V part is also under-rated for the boosted rail.

parsed.summary: Most of the board matches the specification closely (FAN53610 topology and caps, barrel-jack battery-disconnect note, S1-as-reset, Q2 display power switch, EPD part identities L1=10 µH, R1=0.47 Ω, C2=1 µF/6.3 V, the three SS2040FL rectifiers, etc.). The one deviation I can read directly off the drawing is C1 on the EPD_Driver sheet, shown as 0.1 µF/16 V where the spec's component table specifies 1 µF/25 V; I report it as a value/rating anomaly with moderate confidence.
